subject: french
title: Foundations: Numbers, Days & Colours
welcome_lead: Stamp your passport with the building blocks of French: numbers, days, months, and colours.
meta_desc: GCSE French foundations: learn numbers 1-20, days of the week, months, and basic colours.
final_note: Bravo! These tiny words show up everywhere — keep stamping them into your memory.

walkthroughs.body_html: Numbers 1-10 are: un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept, huit, neuf, dix. Then 11-16 each have their own word: onze, douze, treize, quatorze, quinze, seize. From 17 you add: dix-sept (10+7), dix-huit, dix-neuf, and finally vingt (20).

The days are lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche. Notice they don't have a capital letter in French! The months also stay lowercase: janvier, février, mars, avril, mai, juin, juillet, août, septembre, octobre, novembre, décembre.
Common colours: rouge (red), bleu (blue), vert (green), jaune (yellow), noir (black), blanc (white). Colours usually go after the noun and agree with it: une voiture rouge, des chaussures noires.
